problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE — إِنَّمَا يُرِيدُ اللَّهُ لِيُذْهِبَ عَنكُمُ الرِّجْسَ أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ

problems.issue: Q. 37:99: إِنّى for إِنِّي; the closing quotation mark is missing in the transcription.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE — إِنِّي ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّي سَيَهْدِينِ

problems.issue: Q. 17:1: أَسْرِىٰ for أَسْرَىٰ, سُبْحَـٰن for سُبْحَانَ, and an intrusive comma before لَيْلًا.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE — سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي أَسْرَىٰ بِعَبْدِهِ لَيْلًا

problems.issue: Q. 7:143: لِمِيفَتِنَا for لِمِيقَاتِنَا (qāf read as fāʾ, alif lost), and مُوسِىٰ for مُوسَىٰ.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE — وَلَمَّا جَاءَ مُوسَىٰ لِمِيقَاتِنَا

problems.arabic: سَنْرِيهِمُ ءَايَتِنَا فِي الاَفاقِ وَفِي أَنفُسِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ يَتَّبَيَّنَ لَهُمْ أَنَّهُ الْحَق م
problems.issue: Q. 41:53 garbled at four points: سَنْرِيهِمُ for سَنُرِيهِمْ, الاَفاقِ for الْآفَاقِ, يَتَّبَيَّنَ for يَتَبَيَّنَ, and a stray م after الْحَق where the final damma of الْحَقُّ stood. The closing quotation mark is missing.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE — سَنُرِيهِمْ آيَاتِنَا فِي الْآفَاقِ وَفِي أَنفُسِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ يَتَبَيَّنَ لَهُمْ أَنَّهُ الْحَقُّ

problems.arabic: فكان المجيئ منه مؤنة ... بالمعونة لا بالمؤنة
problems.issue: Not OCR damage but an untranslatable pun: مؤنة ('cost, provision borne by oneself') against معونة ('help given from outside'). Rendered 'at his own cost' / 'by [His] help, not at our own cost', which loses the sound-play.
problems.conjecture: No emendation proposed; flagged for the editor in case a note is wanted at this point.

problems.arabic: بين أن يدخل نصف أمني الجنة
problems.issue: أمني for أمتي (tāʾ marbūṭa read as nūn); translated as 'my community'.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE — نصف أمتي

problems.issue: Q. 93:5: the accusative tanwīn on يُعْطِيكً is spurious, رَبُّك lacks its case vowel, and فَتَرْضِىٌّ carries a damma-tanwīn where فَتَرْضَىٰ is required. The closing quotation mark is missing.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE — وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَىٰ

problems.arabic: وقال: أح أول من تنشق عنه الأرض
problems.issue: أح is not a word; marked illegible rather than silently emended. A subject pronoun is required before أول.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE — أنا ('I am the first for whom the earth will split open'), the wording of the well-known ḥadīth

problems.issue: OCR damage in the Qurʾānic lemma: qāf read as fāʾ twice (فاب for قاب, فوسي for قوسين) and أدنى rendered آدنبى with an intrusive bāʾ. Translated from the restored text.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: قاب قوسين أو أدنى (Q. 53:9), restored from the canonical reading.

problems.issue: Dotting error in the lemma: صعقاً printed as صعفاً. Niasse's own gloss (أي مغشيا عليه) confirms the intended word. Translated from the restored text.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: وخرّ موسى صعقاً (Q. 7:143).

problems.issue: Dotting error in the lemma: nūn printed as tāʾ, giving the non-word التبيين for النبيين. Translated from the restored text.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: وخاتم النبيين (Q. 33:40).

problems.arabic: (وَءَاتَيْنَا عِيسَى ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ ألْبَيِّنَتِ وَأَيَّدْنَهُ) ... {فَمنْهُم مَنَ اَمَنَ)
problems.issue: Throughout ¶13–¶16 the bracket types do not match: lemmata open with ( and close with }, or open with { and close with ). Lemma boundaries therefore rest on the Jalālayn parallel rather than on the transcription's punctuation. (The alif-less spellings — ألبينت, أيدنه, رزقنكم, الكفرون, الظلمون, شفعة — are ʿUthmānic rasm, not OCR damage, and were not emended.)
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: boundaries as segmented in the runs above, following Jalālayn on Q. 2:253–254.

problems.issue: The closing brace of the lemma is missing and the lemma runs together with the following gloss (كفر + كالنصارى), so the division between Qurʾānic text and gloss is not marked in the transcription.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: lemma {ومنهم من كفر}, gloss كالنصارى بعد المسيح — as translated.

problems.issue: Dotting error in the lemma: qāf read as fāʾ, giving افتتلوا for اقتتلوا. Translated from the restored text.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: ولو شاء الله ما اقتتلوا (Q. 2:253).

problems.issue: Dotting error in the lemma: nūn printed as tāʾ (ءامتوا for the rasm ءامنوا). Translated from the restored text.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: يا أيها الذين آمنوا (Q. 2:254).

problems.issue: Dotting error in the lemma: fāʾ read as qāf, giving شقعة for the rasm شفعة. The gloss that follows (بغير إذنه) confirms intercession. Translated from the restored text.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: ولا شفاعة / rasm ولا شفعة (Q. 2:254).

problems.arabic: أفضل القرآن  وأفضل آياتِها آية الكرسي
problems.issue: A lacuna at the double space in the ḥadīth: the feminine pronoun in آياتها has no antecedent in the text as transmitted, so the name of a sūra has dropped out. Marked [lacuna] in the translation rather than supplied.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: أفضل القرآن سورة البقرة وأفضل آياتها آية الكرسي, on the parallel ḥadīth naming Sūrat al-Baqara.

problems.arabic: المستغني عن كل ما سواه لمفتقر إليه كلُّ ما عداه
problems.issue: The definite article of المفتقر is reduced to a single lām (لمفتقر), which as it stands is ungrammatical in apposition to الواجب الوجود / المستغني. Translated from the restored text.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: المفتقر إليه كل ما عداه.

problems.arabic: لب اللب هو الزيتون الذي يخرج من اللب
problems.issue: The transcription reads al-zaytūn (“the olive”), which does not fit “what comes out of the kernel”; the three-term figure (husk / kernel / kernel of the kernel) requires the pressed product, not the fruit.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read الزيت (al-zayt, “the oil”); translated as “the oil.”

problems.issue: إله is missing from the formula; as it stands the phrase reads lā illā Llāh. This may be OCR loss of a word, or a deliberate point about the wạ̄silūn dropping even “ilāha.”
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: OCR drop of إله, i.e. لا إله إلا الله. Left as transcribed (lā illā Llāh) with a bracketed English gloss, since the deliberate reading is also possible.

problems.arabic: اللَّه لَاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ … {لا تَاخُذُهُ} … {سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوَمٌ} … السَّمَوَٰت … وَهَوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمْ)
problems.issue: Systematic OCR corruption of the Āyat al-Kursī lemmata: hamza lost (تاخذه for تأخذه), stray and wrong vowel marks (نَوَمٌ for نَوْمٌ, وَهَوَ for وَهُوَ, العطيمْ with sukun), and unmatched quotation marks and braces around the lemmata.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: the standard text of Q. 2:255 throughout; the damage is orthographic only and does not affect the English. Translated from the standard reading.

problems.issue: مِح is not a word; the citation requires a preposition here.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read في (fī, “in”), on the parallel of the same citation given two clauses earlier; translated as “in.”

problems.issue: A stray و stands between the verb and its subject, where Q. 2:255 has none; the shādda on تاخذّه is also spurious.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: OCR artifact, to be deleted; read لا تأخذه سنة. Translated without the و.

problems.issue: أسقطن does not agree with the second-person singular address used in the parallel clauses before and after it (إن أسقطت الألف … وإن أسقطت اللام الثانية).
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read أسقطت; translated as “if you drop.”

problems.issue: إلة for إله (tāʾ for hāʾ) and إلّهو run together for إلا هو.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read هو الله لا إله إلا هو; translated accordingly.

problems.arabic: "لِلهِ مَا فِي السَّمَوَاتِ وَالاَرْضِ" … "لَهْ مَا … السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ" … "هُوَ ٱللَّهُ لَا إِلَةَ إِلَّهُو"
problems.issue: The three citations adduced to illustrate the dropping of letters from the word Allāh do not correspond exactly to any single āya: لله ما في السماوات والأرض lacks the وما في of Q. 2:284, and هو الله لا إله إلا هو is a composite of Q. 59:22 and Q. 2:255. The quotation is loose, as often in the oral delivery.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: the intended references are Q. 2:284 (or 24:64), Q. 2:116, and Q. 59:22 (or 2:255); given with “cf.” rather than a bare reference.

problems.issue: كلا stands alone after the verb and may be either a truncated كلاهما (“both of them”) or the oral negative كلاّ (“no”), i.e. a self-correction before the restatement وجد القارورتين كسرتا جميعا.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read كلاهما, translated “both of them”; the alternative reading is a spoken self-correction (“— no —”), which the following clause would then restate.

problems.arabic: وسكت عن الآخر[17]، علم ما قيل له موته خير له.
problems.issue: The final clause lacks the particles needed to govern it: no من/أن after علم, and no antecedent for the pronoun in موته. Most likely a dropped من and أن in transmission; علم may be active (عَلِمَ) or passive (عُلِمَ).
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: عُلِمَ مما قيل له أنّ موته خير له — 'it is known from what was said to him [the first] that the other's death is better for him'; the contrast with فحياتك خير من موتك supports this reading. Translated with the supplied words in brackets.

problems.issue: A stray opening brace stands inside the gloss, between تنافي and البنوة. البنوة is not Qurʾānic here, so the brace cannot mark a lemma at that point.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: the brace belongs to the following lemma, i.e. والملكية تنافي البنوة {من ذا الذي يشفع عنده}; the brace has slipped one word left. Translated with البنوة as gloss ("p").

problems.issue: OCR defects in the lemma: السَّمَوَتِ lacks the alif of السماوات, and الأَرْضُ carries a nominative ending where the accusative الأرضَ is required as second object.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: وسع كرسيّه السماوات والأرضَ (Q. 2:255). Reading certain against the Qurʾānic text; translated normally.

problems.arabic: حفظك اللّٰه من الشيطان وحفظ من معك في البيت والبيوت حول )
problems.issue: The ḥadīth breaks off: حول stands without its pronoun or relative clause, and the closing parenthesis follows a space, so a word has been lost at the line end.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: والبيوت حولك ('and the houses around you'); التي حوله or حولها is also possible. Translated as 'around [you]' with the supplied pronoun bracketed.

problems.issue: Mismatched delimiters: the lemma opens with { and closes with ), and the next lemma opens with { again. The run of delimiters in this paragraph is unstable throughout, so bracket shape cannot be used to tell lemma from gloss.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read {ألم تر إلى الذي حاجَّ} as a single lemma. Register assigned from content (Q. 2:258), not from the brackets.

problems.arabic: { إبْرَهِيمَ فِي رَبِّمِهِ أَنَ اتِـيهُ اللَّهُ أَلْمَلْكَ}
problems.issue: Two OCR corruptions: رَبِّمِهِ carries an intrusive ميم, and أَنَ اتِـيهُ splits one word and loses the alif madda of آتاه. ألْمَلْكَ also shows a hamzated article.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: إبراهيمَ في ربّه أن آتاه الله المُلكَ (Q. 2:258). Reading certain against the Qurʾānic text; translated normally.

problems.arabic: {وَالذِينَ كَفَرْوَاْ أَوْلِيَأوَّهُمْ ألطَّغُوتُ يُخْرِجُونَهُم مِنَ ألنَّورِ}
problems.issue: Hamza and alif damage across the lemma: كَفَرْوَاْ for كفروا, أَوْلِيَأوَّهُمْ for أولياءُهم, and the article written أل for ال in ألطّاغوت and ألنّور. The same أل- defect recurs in ألعَلِىُّ and ألمَلْكَ, and أؤولِّئِكَ أَصْحَبُ stands for أولٰئك أصحابُ.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: والذين كفروا أولياءُهم الطّاغوتُ يخرجونهم من النّور (Q. 2:257). Readings certain against the Qurʾānic text; translated normally.

problems.issue: الرُّشْدْ carries a sukun where the nominative الرُّشدُ is required, and ألْغَييّ has the أل- article defect together with a doubled ياء.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: قد تبيّن الرُّشدُ من الْغَيّ (Q. 2:256). Reading certain; translated normally.

problems.arabic: نزلت فيمن كان له من الأنصار أولاد أرادوا أن يكرهوهم على الإسلام
problems.issue: أرادوا is plural while its antecedent من كان له is singular, and no relative pronoun links أولاد to يكرهوهم. The Jalālayn wording has أولادٌ أرادوا, so this may be the source reading rather than OCR.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read من as generic and the verb as agreeing ad sensum — 'those of the Anṣār who had children whom they wanted to compel to Islam'. Translated on that reading.

problems.issue: Initial nūn lost to OCR; the same name is spelled نمرود بن كنعان twice later in this paragraph.
problems.conjecture: نمرود بن كنعان, Namrūd b. Kanʿān; translated as '[Nam]rūd b. Kanʿān' — conjecture.

problems.arabic: {إِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَهِيمُ) ... ( رَبِّىَ الَّذِى يُحْيِ وَيُمِيتُ)
problems.issue: Lemma delimiters are corrupt: braces are closed by parentheses and parentheses by braces, so the boundaries of the Qurʾānic lemmata had to be set from Q. 2:258 rather than from the transcription.
problems.conjecture: Boundaries taken as {إِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ} and {رَبِّيَ الَّذِي يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ} — conjecture.

problems.issue: OCR corruption inside the lemma: doubled nūn in أَنَّا and a spurious final hamza in أُحْيء.
problems.conjecture: أَنَا أُحْيِي وَأُمِيتُ (Q. 2:258) — conjecture; translated on that reading.

problems.arabic: فإِنَّ اللَّه يَاتِى بِالشَّمْسِ مِنَ الْمَشْرِقِ فَاتِ بِهَا
problems.issue: Hamzas lost in يَاتِى and فَاتِ.
problems.conjecture: فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأْتِي بِالشَّمْسِ مِنَ الْمَشْرِقِ فَأْتِ بِهَا — conjecture; translated on that reading.

problems.arabic: يطلب المير ... حرمه المير ... بدون مير
problems.issue: Unpointed OCR leaves the noun ambiguous; read as مِير, grain provisions, which the following bread story supports.
problems.conjecture: مِير / مِيرة, 'provisions' — conjecture; translated 'provisions' throughout.

problems.issue: ظ read as ط by OCR.
problems.conjecture: فلما استيقظ إبراهيم, 'when Ibrāhīm awoke' — conjecture; translated on that reading.

problems.issue: مف is not a word and the subject of فقال is lost; emitted as an illegible span rather than filled in.
problems.conjecture: فقال اللّٰه للملائكة, 'So Allah said to the angels' — conjecture, since the angels have just raised their objection and the speaker then commands them to test Ibrāhīm.

problems.arabic: وإن زدت أعطيتك جميع ما عندي من الممالك
problems.issue: الممالك is ambiguous between 'kingdoms' and owned property; the narrative concerns herds and household wealth, not realms.
problems.conjecture: مَمَالِك in the sense of owned property; translated 'possessions' — conjecture.

problems.issue: The paragraph ends mid-clause at the page division and the continuation is missing, since ¶33 carries no text; the vocative يا has no complement.
problems.conjecture: Something on the order of حق لهذا يا رب أن يكون خليلك, 'this one deserves, O Lord, to be Your khalīl' — conjecture; not translated.

problems.issue: The paragraph body is absent from the transcription: a single hyphen stands where the text of the page should be.
problems.conjecture: The missing text continues the angel's report broken off at the end of ¶32 and presumably completes the khalīl etymology — conjecture; nothing translated.

problems.issue: OCR has كَالذِ for كالذي (final yāʾ lost); the case ending on قرية is also lost.
problems.conjecture: Conjecture: كالذي مرَّ على قريةٍ (Q. 2:259); translated accordingly.

problems.arabic: { يُحْي هَذِهِ اللَّهُ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا} ... كيف يحى اللّه هذه المدينة
problems.issue: OCR has يُحْي and يحى for يحيي in both lemma and gloss.
problems.conjecture: Conjecture: يُحْيِي in both places; sense unaffected, translated as 'give life to'.

problems.issue: The genitive of لقدرة has no governing noun: الله is missing before تعالى.
problems.conjecture: Conjecture: لقدرة الله تعالى; 'Allah' supplied in square brackets in the translation.

problems.issue: Opening brace lost, so the left edge of the lemma is not marked; only the closing brace survives.
problems.conjecture: Conjecture: {فأماته الله}; the whole phrase is Qurʾānic (Q. 2:259) and is marked as a lemma.

problems.issue: OCR has مِأْيَةَ عَامِ for مائة عام (hamza misplaced, case ending on عام lost).
problems.conjecture: Conjecture: مائةَ عامٍ; translated 'a hundred years'.

problems.issue: OCR has آوْ (alif madda) for أو.
problems.conjecture: Conjecture: أو بعض يومٍ; translated 'or part of a day'.

problems.issue: OCR has الْعِظَمِ for العظام; the following gloss (عظام حمارك) and Q. 2:259 both require the plural العظام.
problems.conjecture: Conjecture: وانظر إلى العظام; translated 'the bones'.

problems.issue: نحيبها is not a word; the gloss on ننشرها must be the verb 'to give life', confirmed by the contrasting Ḥafṣ gloss (أي حركها) that opens ¶36.
problems.conjecture: Conjecture: نحييها ('we give them life'); translated accordingly.

problems.arabic: وقراءة حفص كيف ننشزها أي حركها
problems.issue: حركها lacks the first-person plural prefix that the paired gloss نحييها has, and the subject of the Qurʾānic verb is 'We'.
problems.conjecture: Conjecture: أي نحرّكها ('that is, We move them'), as in the Jalālayn gloss نحركها ونرفعها; translated 'We move them'.

problems.issue: Mismatched lemma delimiters: the span opens with a parenthesis and closes with a brace.
problems.conjecture: Conjecture: a single bracket type was intended, {ثم نكسوها لحماً}; the span is Qurʾānic (Q. 2:259) and is marked as a lemma.

problems.issue: A stray Arabic-Indic digit ٣ stands inside the lemma after قدير.
problems.conjecture: Conjecture: the remains of an end-of-āya marker for Q. 2:259 (٢٥٩); omitted from the translation.

problems.issue: فقط in final position is hard to construe; it may be a restrictive adverb ('nothing but/no less than') or the remains of a longer clause.
problems.conjecture: Conjecture: restrictive reading, 'this one is nothing less than the son of Allah'; translated that way.

problems.arabic: "قَالَ أَنَبى يُحْيِ هَذِهِ اللَّهُ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا
problems.issue: OCR has أَنَبى for أنَّى, and the quotation that opens the lemma is never closed.
problems.conjecture: Conjecture: "قال أنَّى يحيي هذه الله بعد موتها" — the reprise of Q. 2:259 already quoted in ¶34; marked as a Qurʾānic lemma despite the double quotation marks.

problems.arabic: { إِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَهِيمٌ رَبِّ أَرِنِي كَيْفَ تُحْيِ الْمَوْتِى)
problems.issue: Mismatched delimiters (opens with a brace, closes with a parenthesis); إِبْرَهِيمٌ is written defectively and carries the wrong case ending, and تُحْيِ stands for تحيي.
problems.conjecture: Conjecture: {إذ قال إبراهيمُ ربِّ أرني كيف تحيي الموتى} (Q. 2:260); translated accordingly.

problems.issue: OCR has dropped the hamza from تؤمن in both occurrences of this lemma (¶39 and ¶41); the form as printed, تومن, is not a Qurʾanic reading.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read تُؤمِن (Q. 2:260), translated “Do you not then believe?”

problems.issue: بَلِى is written with kasra and final yāʾ for بَلَى; also وَلَكِن for وَلـٰكِن. Vowelling damage only, sense secure.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read قَالَ بَلَى وَلـٰكِن لِيَطْمَئِنَّ قَلْبِي (Q. 2:260).

problems.issue: The same word is corrupted three different ways in one paragraph: the nūn of اطمئنانهم is read once as hamza-on-yāʾ and once as tāʾ. Translated from the conjecture in all three places.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read اطمِئنانُهم “their being at rest” throughout.

problems.issue: The final ḍamma of القلوبُ has been scanned as a shadda, and the shadda of تَطْمَئِنُّ is misplaced onto the wrong consonant.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read أَلا بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ الْقُلُوبُ (Q. 13:28).

problems.arabic: «أَوَلَمْ تُومِن قَالَ بلَى« وَلَكِن ليَطْمَئِنَّ فَلْبِه»
problems.issue: Two defects. (a) The lemma brackets are garbled: a second opening « stands where a closing » belongs, so the lemma boundary is indeterminate. (b) فَلْبِه is not a word; qāf has been read as fāʾ and the final yāʾ as hāʾ.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read as one continuous lemma «أَوَلَمْ تُؤمِن قَالَ بَلَى وَلـٰكِن لِيَطْمَئِنَّ قَلْبِي» (Q. 2:260).

problems.arabic: فَخُذَ أَرْبَعَةً مِنَ الطَّيْرِ فَصْرْهُنَّ إِلَيْكَ
problems.issue: فَخُذَ for فَخُذْ (imperative), and فَصْرْهُنَّ carries sukūn where the ḍamma of فَصُرْهُنَّ belongs — two consecutive unvowelled consonants, impossible as printed.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read فَخُذْ أَرْبَعَةً مِنَ الطَّيْرِ فَصُرْهُنَّ إِلَيْكَ (Q. 2:260).

problems.arabic: ثُمَّ آَدْعُهُنَّ يَاتِينَكَ سَعْيًا … وَاعْلَمَ آنَّ اللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيم
problems.issue: Hamza/madda confusion through the whole lemma: آَدْعُهُنَّ for ادْعُهُنَّ, يَاتِينَكَ for يَأْتِينَكَ, وَاعْلَمَ آنَّ for وَاعْلَمْ أَنَّ, and حَكِيم without its tanwīn.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read ثُمَّ ادْعُهُنَّ يَأْتِينَكَ سَعْيًا … وَاعْلَمْ أَنَّ اللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ (Q. 2:260).

problems.arabic: فتلاءم حتى اجتمع كلا والتحق براسه
problems.issue: كلا does not construe here; and براسه has lost the hamza of برأسه. Translated from the conjecture.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read حتى اجتمع كلُّه والتحق برأسه “until the whole of it was joined and was attached to its head”; كله misread as كلا.

problems.issue: الزية is not a word. The nūn of الزينة has dropped out — confirmed by التزين a few lines later, where the same trait is named in the list of dispositions to be shed.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read الزِّينة “adornment”.

problems.arabic: هذه السبع أبواب جهنم "لَهَا سَبْعَةُ أَبْوَابٍ لِكُلِّ بَابٍ مِنْهُمْ جُزْءٌ مَفْسُوم،
problems.issue: Two defects. (a) مَفْسُوم for مَقْسُومٌ — qāf read as fāʾ, and the tanwīn lost. (b) The opening double quotation mark is never closed, so the lemma's end is marked only by the comma; I have taken the lemma to end at مقسوم and فمن جاهد to resume Niasse's own prose.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read جُزْءٌ مَقْسُومٌ" (Q. 15:44).

problems.arabic: فهذه سبع: ظهر الحرص وزوجته الحسد
problems.issue: ظهر sits oddly at the head of an enumeration that otherwise has no verb; it may be a scan of a different word. Rendered literally as “there appeared”.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: possibly ظهر as printed (“there appeared covetousness and its wife envy”); alternatively a corruption of فهذه سبع أشطر / هي or of a repeated فهذه. Not emended.

problems.arabic: وهذه الطيور فيها طباع بني ادم
problems.issue: ادم without madda for آدم; the same name is correctly written آدم later in the paragraph.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read بني آدم “the sons of Adam”.

problems.arabic: مَثَلْ ألذِين يُنفِقُونَ أَمْوَلَهُمْ … حَبَّةٍ آنْبَتَتْ سَبْعَ سَنَابِلَ فِي كُلِّ سُنْبْلَةٍ ماْئَةُ حَبَّةِ
problems.issue: The lemma is orthographically degraded throughout: مَثَلْ for مَثَلُ, ألذين for الَّذِينَ, أَمْوَلَهُم for أَمْوَالَهُم, آنْبَتَتْ for أَنْبَتَتْ, سُنْبْلَة with sukūn for سُنْبُلَة, and حَبَّةِ in the genitive for حَبَّةٍ. Sense is not in doubt. The second citation of the same āya in ¶44 is in a different (Warsh-style) orthography and is sound.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read as Q. 2:261, مَثَلُ الَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ أَمْوَالَهُمْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ كَمَثَلِ حَبَّةٍ أَنْبَتَتْ سَبْعَ سَنَابِلَ فِي كُلِّ سُنْبُلَةٍ مِائَةُ حَبَّةٍ.

problems.arabic: وقال له علَيَّ ألف بعير كل بعير بحمله من البر
problems.issue: البر is unpointed and ambiguous between البُرّ “wheat” and البرّ “land”; with بحمله “with its load” only the former construes. Also, the extent of ʿUthmān's direct speech is unmarked in the transcription — I have closed it at وأحلاسها and taken وأتى بألف دينار as Niasse's narration.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read البُرّ “wheat”; quotation closed at وأحلاسها.

problems.issue: Two defects in one lemma. يُضعِفْ carries sukun on the final radical of a verb in the imperfect indicative, which is impossible, and has lost the alif of the third form; وَسِعٌ has lost the alif of وَاسِعٌ. Sense is not in doubt.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read وَاللَّهُ يُضَاعِفُ لِمَن يَشَاءُ وَاللَّهُ وَاسِعٌ (Q. 2:261).

problems.arabic: {عَلِيم ٱلْذِينَ يُنفِقونَ ...} · {... وَلا هُمْ يَحْزَنونَ قَوْلٌ مَعْروفٌ}
problems.issue: The lemma braces do not respect verse boundaries: a single brace repeatedly holds the close of one aya and the opening of the next (here the end of Q. 2:261 with the start of 2:262, and the end of 2:262 with the start of 2:263; again at ¶46, الْكَـٰفِرِينَ وَمَِلَ اَلذِيَن, and at ¶50, الأَلْبَابُ وَمَا أَنْفَقْتُم). I have split each such brace into separate q runs and placed the reference where each verse closes rather than where the brace closes.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: the printed brace boundaries are compositorial, not Niasse's citation units; no emendation to the Arabic is implied.

problems.arabic: ٱلْذِينَ يُنفِقونَ أَمْوَلَهُمْ فِى سَبِيلِ اللهِ ... {لَهُمَ أَجْرُهُمْ
problems.issue: The Q. 2:262 lemma is orthographically degraded throughout: ٱلْذِينَ for الَّذِينَ, أَمْوَلَهُمْ for أَمْوَالَهُمْ, فِى for فِي, مَآ for مَا, and لَهُمَ with fatha for لَهُمْ. Sense is not in doubt.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read as Q. 2:262, الَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ أَمْوَالَهُمْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ لا يُتْبِعُونَ مَا أَنفَقُوا مَنًّا ... لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ.

problems.issue: تعير does not construe with له: a verbal noun is required in parallel with المن. One ya' has dropped out of تعيير; the reading is secured by the parallel in the Jalalayn gloss on the same phrase. Translated from the conjecture.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read وتعيير له بالسؤال “and by shaming him for having asked.”

problems.issue: يُومِنُ has lost the hamza of يُؤمِنُ — the same defect logged for ¶39 and ¶41 of the preceding chunk — and الأَخِرِ has lost the madda of الآخِرِ.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read وَلا يُؤمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ (Q. 2:264).

problems.issue: The paragraph ends inside the lemma at the foot of the printed page and the brace is never closed; the lemma is completed only by the gloss that opens ¶46 (صلبا أملس لا شيء عليه). صَلْدًاَ also carries both tanwin and a stray fatha.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read فَتَرَكَهُ صَلْدًا (Q. 2:264); the brace closes here and the exposition resumes at ¶46.

problems.issue: يَفْدِرونَ is not a word: qaf has been read as fa', the same substitution found at مَفْسوم and فَلْبِه in the preceding chunk and at بافية in ¶50 below.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read لا يَقْدِرُونَ (Q. 2:264), “they have no power.”

problems.arabic: {وَمَِلَ اَلذِيَن يُنفِقونَ أَمْوَلَهمُ اِبْتَغَآءَ مَرْضَاتِ اللَّهِ وَتَثْبيتاً مِنَ انفُسِهِمْ}
problems.issue: The Q. 2:265 lemma is degraded at almost every word: وَمَِلَ for وَمَثَلُ (the tha' unpointed and the case ending wrong), اَلذِيَن for الَّذِينَ with the vowel displaced onto the ya', أَمْوَلَهمُ for أَمْوَالَهُمْ, اِبْتَغَآءَ for ابْتِغَاءَ (kasra read as fatha), and مِنَ انفُسِهِمْ for مِنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ. Sense is not in doubt.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read وَمَثَلُ الَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ أَمْوَالَهُمْ ابْتِغَاءَ مَرْضَاتِ اللَّهِ وَتَثْبِيتًا مِنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ (Q. 2:265).

problems.issue: Three defects in the garden simile. بِرْبْوَةٍ has sukun where the fatha of بِرَبْوَةٍ belongs, giving two unvowelled consonants in succession. فَئاتَتُ is not a form: the madda of فَآتَتْ has been scanned as hamza-on-ya', and the final ta' carries damma for sukun. اكْلَهَا has lost both the hamza and the vowelling of أُكُلَهَا.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read بِرَبْوَةٍ أَصَابَهَا وَابِلٌ فَآتَتْ أُكُلَهَا ضِعْفَيْنِ (Q. 2:265).

problems.issue: The paragraph again ends inside the lemma at the page foot with the brace unclosed, and the lemma is resumed in ¶47 only after the gloss أيحب. أَيوَدَ has also lost the shadda and the case ending of أَيَوَدُّ.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read أَيَوَدُّ أَحَدُكُمْ (Q. 2:266), the lemma running across the page break.

problems.arabic: {أَحَدُكُمُؓ أَن تَكونَ لَهُ جَنَّةٌ} ... {مِن نَّخيلٍ وَأَعْنَبِ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا الاَنْهَرُ}
problems.issue: Alif-maqsura and madda damage through the Q. 2:266 lemma: أَحَدُكُمُؓ carries a damma plus a stray madda for أَحَدُكُمْ; وَأَعْنَبِ has lost the alif and the tanwin of وَأَعْنَابٍ; تَجْرِى stands for تَجْرِي; الاَنْهَرُ for الأَنْهَارُ.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read أَحَدُكُمْ أَن تَكُونَ لَهُ جَنَّةٌ مِن نَّخِيلٍ وَأَعْنَابٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الأَنْهَارُ (Q. 2:266).

problems.issue: The lemma is cut at the page foot with the brace unclosed and is closed at the head of ¶48 by a round bracket, so one citation is delimited by { at its opening and ) at its close. The delimiter mismatch is compositorial; the lemma itself is continuous.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read as one lemma فَأَصَابَهَا إِعْصَارٌ فِيهِ نَارٌ فَاحْتَرَقَتْ (Q. 2:266).

problems.arabic: {كَذَلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ اللَّهُ لَكُمُؓ الاَيَٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَفكِّرونَ}
problems.issue: لَكُمُؓ again carries the stray madda seen at أَحَدُكُمُؓ in ¶47; الاَيَٰتِ has lost the madda of الآيَاتِ; and تَتَفكِّرونَ is vowelled as a fifth-form with kasra for تَتَفَكَّرُونَ.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read كَذَلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ اللَّهُ لَكُمُ الآيَاتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَفَكَّرُونَ (Q. 2:266).

problems.arabic: {مِن طَيِّبَتِ مَا كَسَبْتُمْ} ... «مِن طَيِّبَتٍ مَا كَسَبْتُمْ»
problems.issue: The same word is corrupted two different ways in one paragraph: the alif of طَيِّبَاتِ is lost in both places, and the case ending differs between the lemma (kasra) and Niasse's re-quotation of it a few lines later (kasratan). Translated identically in both places, since he is quoting the same words back.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read مِن طَيِّبَاتِ مَا كَسَبْتُمْ (Q. 2:267) in both occurrences.

problems.issue: يَعِدْكُمُ carries sukun on the second radical of an imperfect indicative, which is impossible, and الْفَقَرَ has fatha where الْفَقْرَ requires sukun.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read الشَّيْطَانُ يَعِدُكُمُ الْفَقْرَ (Q. 2:268).

problems.issue: Three defects in one short lemma. The bracket opens with { and closes with ), as at the ¶47/¶48 break. وَيَامُرْكُم has lost the hamza of وَيَأْمُرُكُم and carries sukun on the ra'. بِالْفَحْشَاءُ takes damma after a preposition, where the genitive is required.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read وَيَأْمُرُكُم بِالْفَحْشَاءِ (Q. 2:268).

problems.issue: A space has been scanned into the middle of وَاسِعٌ, splitting it into وَ and سِعٌ. The same word was corrupted differently at ¶45 (وَسِعٌ), so the two occurrences fail in two distinct ways.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read وَاللَّهُ وَاسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ (Q. 2:268).

problems.arabic: قال الرسول: لا تخرج الصدقة إلا بعد أن انتزعت من يد سبعين شيطانا.[31]
problems.issue: The hadith has no closing mark in the transcription, so its extent is unmarked. I have closed it at شيطانا and taken والصدقة إذا خرجت as Niasse's own resumption; the five sayings of the charity that follow are therefore set as his prose, not as quoted hadith.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: quotation closed at سبعين شيطانا, the point at which footnote 31 is keyed.

problems.issue: بافية is not a word: qaf read as fa' once more. The reading is secured by the parallel فانية فأبقيتني in ¶49, which pairs the same two roots. Translated from the conjecture.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read كانت فانية فصارت باقية “it was perishing and became enduring.”

problems.arabic: كانت قليلة ... كانت محروسة فصارت حارسة، كانت فانية فصارت بافية
problems.issue: The five sayings are listed in ¶50 in a different order from ¶49, where the sequence is قليلة – صغيرة – فانية – محروسة – عدو; here the third and fourth members are transposed. Not emended: I have translated each list in the order printed.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: oral variation in the repetition rather than line damage, since both lists are complete and internally coherent; but a transposition in the setting of ¶50 cannot be excluded.

problems.arabic: بعدما كانت الدنيا وما فيها قليلو والعلم قليل
problems.issue: قليلو is not a word and does not agree with الدنيا; the final letter is a misread ta'-marbuta or a stray waw carried over from the following والعلم. Translated from the conjecture.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read قليلة “little”, agreeing with الدنيا.

problems.issue: The most damaged span in the chunk: اءلواالأَلْبَابُ runs two words together with a free-standing hamza and a doubled alif, and the final noun takes damma where the genitive is required after أُولُو. Recoverable with certainty from the aya; translated from the conjecture.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read وَمَا يَذَّكَّرُ إِلَّا أُولُو الأَلْبَابِ (Q. 2:269).

problems.arabic: {يُوتى الْحِكْمَةَ} ... {مَنْ يَشَآءٌ وَمَنْ يُوتَ الْحِكْمَةَ فَقَدُ أوتِىَ خيْراً كثيرا}
problems.issue: Hamza loss and vowel damage through the Q. 2:269 lemma: يُوتى and يُوتَ for يُؤْتِي and يُؤْتَ, يَشَآءٌ with tanwin for يَشَاءُ, فَقَدُ for فَقَدْ, أوتِىَ for أُوتِيَ, and خيْراً كثيرا unvowelled.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read يُؤْتِي الْحِكْمَةَ مَن يَشَاءُ وَمَن يُؤْتَ الْحِكْمَةَ فَقَدْ أُوتِيَ خَيْرًا كَثِيرًا (Q. 2:269).

problems.arabic: {آوْ نَذَرْتُم مِن نَذْرِ} ... {فَإِنَّ أللَّهَ يَعْلَمْهُ } ... {وَمَا لِلطَّـٰلِمِينَ مِنَ أنصارَ}
problems.issue: The Q. 2:270 lemma is damaged at four points: آوْ carries a madda for أَوْ; نَذْرِ is genitive where the tanwin of نَذْرٍ belongs; أللَّهَ has a hamza on the article; يَعْلَمْهُ has sukun for the damma of the indicative; and مِنَ أنصارَ has both the wrong vowel on مِنْ and the wrong ending on أَنصَارٍ.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read أَوْ نَذَرْتُم مِن نَذْرٍ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُهُ وَمَا لِلطَّالِمِينَ مِنْ أَنصَارٍ (Q. 2:270).

problems.issue: The chunk ends inside the lemma with the brace unclosed, the fourth such mid-lemma page break here (cf. ¶45, ¶46, ¶47). The citation continues into the next chunk.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: the lemma continues إِن تُبْدُوا الصَّدَقَاتِ فَنِعِمَّا هِيَ (Q. 2:271); also تَبْدُواْ for تُبْدُوا.

problems.issue: Three defects in the Q. 2:271 lemmata. هِيّ carries a shadda where the fatḥa of هِيَ belongs; تُوتُوهَا has lost the hamza of تُؤْتُوهَا; خَيرُ has lost its tanwīn. (فَهْوَ is the Warsh reading, not damage.) Sense is not in doubt; translated from the conjecture.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read فَنِعِمَّا هِيَ … وَتُؤْتُوهَا الْفُقَرَاءَ فَهْوَ خَيرٌ لَكُمْ (Q. 2:271).

problems.arabic: فإخفاءها خير{[33] وَنُكَفِّرْ عَنكُم مِن سَيِّئاتِكُمْ}
problems.issue: The opening brace has been scanned before the footnote marker [33], so the marker falls inside the lemma. The marker belongs to the preceding prose word خير, where the sentence on concealing alms ends; the lemma begins at ونكفر. I have placed [33] at the end of the prose run and opened the lemma at ونكفر.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read فإخفاءها خير[33] {وَنُكَفِّرْ عَنكُم …}.

problems.issue: Four defects in the Q. 2:285 run: سبعنَا for سَمِعْنَا (mīm read as bāʾ); a bare ه standing between the lemma and its gloss; غفراناك in the gloss for غُفْرَانَك, with an intrusive alif; and وَالَيْكَ for وَإِلَيْكَ, with الْمَصِير stripped of its final ḍamma and the lemma's closing bracket missing. problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read وَقَالُوا سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ (Q. 2:285); gloss نسألك غفرانك.

problems.issue: بما does not construe: the clause needs a pronoun referring back to what the souls harbour, and the comma falls where the sentence has not ended. Translated from the conjecture.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read وشق عليهم المحاسبة بها, “being brought to account for it weighed heavily upon them”.

problems.issue: تَجْسا for نَفْسًا, the nūn read as tāʾ and the fāʾ as jīm; and الأَوَسْعَهَا, in which إِلَّا and وُسْعَهَا have been run together and the doubled lām reanalysed as a definite article. لا يَكَلِّف and أَللّه also want their vowels. The same lemma is cited soundly across the ¶63/¶64 break, which fixes the reading.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read لا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا (Q. 2:286).

problems.arabic: (إِن نَسِينَا أَوَ اخطَأْنَام تركنا الصواب عن عمد
problems.issue: Two defects, the second substantive. (a) أَوَ اخطَأْنَام for أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا, with a stray mīm where the closing bracket belongs. (b) The gloss reads تركنا الصواب عن عمد, “we abandoned what is right deliberately”, which inverts the sense: the āya asks pardon precisely for what is not deliberate, and the following clause كما آخذت به من قبلنا requires it. The negative لا has dropped out. I have supplied it in square brackets in the translation rather than silently.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا (Q. 2:286), glossed تركنا الصواب لا عن عمد, “we abandoned what is right, not deliberately”.

problems.arabic: (وَعَلَيْهَا مَا إكْتَسَبَتْ) … رَبَا ) … كما آخذت به من قبلنا
problems.issue: Lesser damage, sense secure in each case: إكْتَسَبَتْ carries a hamza that اكْتَسَبَتْ does not take; رَبَا is a scan of رَبَّنَا with the nūn and shadda lost, and it is followed by a closing ) where the opening bracket belongs; and آخذت stands for أَخَذْتَ.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ … رَبَّنَا (Q. 2:286) … كما أَخَذْتَ به من قبلنا.

problems.arabic: عَلَى ألذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا … (وَاعْف عَنَّا)) امح ذنوبنا ( وَاغْفِرلَنَا وَارْحَمْنَام) … ( أَنتَ مَوْلِينَا) … اِلْكـٰفرين
problems.issue: The Q. 2:286 run is degraded throughout, without the wording ever being in doubt: ألذِينَ for الَّذِينَ; a doubled closing bracket after وَاعْف عَنَّا, which also wants its ḍamma (وَاعْفُ); وَاغْفِرلَنَا set without a word space; a stray mīm on وَارْحَمْنَام, the same defect as in ¶66; مَوْلِينَا for مَوْلَانَا; and اِلْكـٰفرين for الْكَافِرِينَ, with a kasra on the article and a taṭwīl stroke standing in for the alif.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا … وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا أَنتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ (Q. 2:286).

problems.issue: Printed as ألّم, which reads as the verb allama, “he caused pain”. At the head of Sūrat Āl ʿImrān this is the disconnected letters alif-lām-mīm, as the gloss that immediately follows confirms (اللّٰه أعلم مراده بذلك). Translated as the letters.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read الم (Q. 3:1), rendered “Alif Lām Mīm”.

problems.arabic: «عيسى هو الله … فهو الله، وتارة يقولون (إن عيسى ابن لله … أبوه> وتارة يقولون (ثالث ثلاثة..
problems.issue: None of the three utterances of the Najrān delegation is properly delimited: the first opens with « and never closes, so its end is marked only by the comma before وتارة; the second opens with ( and closes with >, a scan of »; the third opens with ( and its closing bracket falls in ¶72, after وفعلت, so the paragraph break cuts that utterance in two. I have taken the first to end at فهو الله and have not reordered anything. The .. after ثالث ثلاثة may mark an elision in the printed edition or a pause in the oral delivery; I cannot tell which and have supplied nothing. Since these speakers are neither ḥadīth nor a named authority, their speech is marked “p”, as the conventions require, even though the printed text encloses it.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read «عيسى هو الله … فهو الله» … «إن عيسى ابن لله … أن اللّٰه هو أبوه» … «ثالث ثلاثة … لقال قلت وفعلت», the last closing in ¶72.

problems.issue: يحبي is not a word; the second yāʾ of يحيي has been read as bāʾ. The parallel ويبرئ الأكمه والأبرص in the same clause confirms the sense.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read يُحيي الموتى, “he gives life to the dead”.

problems.arabic: قال: وعيسى يأتيه الموت؟ قالوا: نعم
problems.issue: The chunk opens inside a report whose speakers are named only in the preceding paragraph (¶72: فقال لهم النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم … قالوا: نعم). No beginning has been supplied. The bare قال / قالوا frames are set as Niasse’s prose and the direct speech on both sides as quoted report, the Prophet’s questions and the Najrān delegation’s answers alike.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: the speaker throughout is the Prophet, ṣ.a.w.s., and the respondents the sixty riders of the Christians of Najrān named in ¶71. Register assignment, not an emendation.

problems.issue: يحدث is unvowelled and ambiguous between yuḥdith (to produce ḥadath, i.e. to relieve oneself) and yuḥaddith (to speak). The argument from bodily need — carried, borne, suckled, eating, drinking — requires the first.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read يُحْدِث, “relieve himself”; translated accordingly.

problems.arabic: قال: تعلمون أن عيسى ادعى النصارى أنّهم قتلوه
problems.issue: Two defects in one clause. (a) ألستم has dropped out before تعلمون, breaking the pattern of the four preceding questions. (b) عيسى is left as a bare topic with no predicate of its own and ادعى stands in the masculine singular against the plural النصارى. Translated as it stands, with the anacoluthon preserved by a dash.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read ألستم تعلمون أن عيسى ادعت النصارى أنهم قتلوه.

problems.arabic: (اللَّه لَا إِلَةَ إِلّا هُوَ ألْحَىُّ الْقَيُّومَ)
problems.issue: Orthographic damage across the lemma: إِلَةَ for إِلٰهَ (the dagger alif read as tāʾ marbūṭa), ألْحَىُّ for الْحَيُّ, and الْقَيُّومَ in the accusative for the nominative الْقَيُّومُ. Sense secure.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read Q. 3:2, اللَّهُ لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ.

problems.arabic: عيسى ليس كذلك ونَزَّلَ عَلَيْكَ) يا محمد (الْكِتَبَ القرآن ( بِالْحَقِّ مُصَدِّقاً لِمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ )
problems.issue: The lemma brackets are broken from here to the end of the paragraph: the opening bracket of نزل عليك is missing, الكتب opens without closing, بالحق opens with ( where the previous lemma should close, and وأنزل التورية opens with { and never closes. Lemma boundaries have been set from the Qurʾānic text, not from the printed marks. A wāw also stands before نزل, which opens Q. 3:3 without one; الْكِتَبَ lacks the alif of الْكِتَابَ.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read (نَزَّلَ عَلَيْكَ) يا محمد (الْكِتَابَ) القرآن (بِالْحَقِّ مُصَدِّقاً لِمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ) (Q. 3:3); the wāw taken as a transcriptional connective and rendered “And He sent down”.

problems.issue: التَّوْرِيَةَ for التَّوْرَاةَ (alif read as yāʾ) and وَالاِنجِيلَ for وَالْإِنجِيلَ. The lemma runs across the āya boundary, وأنزل التوراة والإنجيل closing Q. 3:3 and من قبل هدى للناس opening Q. 3:4; cited as Q. 3:3–4.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read وَأَنزَلَ التَّوْرَاةَ وَالْإِنجِيلَ مِن قَبْلُ هُدىً لِلنَّاسِ.

problems.arabic: ومحمد أتى بكتاب من عنا اللّٰه
problems.issue: عنا does not construe; the dāl of عند has dropped out. The same phrase من عند الله is written correctly twice in the same paragraph.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read من عند الله, “from Allah”.

problems.arabic: إذاً كيف يومَن بنبي ويُكفَر بمحمد
problems.issue: يومَن has lost the hamza of يُؤمَن — the same defect that recurs through the corpus in تومن for تؤمن.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read يُؤمَن بنبيّ ويُكفَر بمحمد, passive throughout.

problems.issue: الجرفان is not a word: the fāʾ has been read as jīm and the qāf lost, with the remaining letters transposed. Q. 3:4 reads وَأَنزَلَ الْفُرْقَانَ, which the gloss immediately following — الكتب الفارقة بين الحق والباطل — confirms. The brackets are also mismatched, { opening and ) closing.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read (وَأَنزَلَ الْفُرْقَانَ) (Q. 3:4), translated “and He sent down the Criterion [al-Furqān]”.

problems.arabic: فاذاً إما أن يُصدق بالجميع أو لكفر بالجميع
problems.issue: لكفر has no construction here; the yāʾ of the parallel passive يُكفَر has been read as lām. Also فاذاً for فإذاً.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read فإذاً إما أن يُصدَّق بالجميع أو يُكفَر بالجميع.

problems.arabic: وَاللَّهُ عَزِيزٓ) … ذُو إنتِفَام عقوبة شديدة عن عصاه
problems.issue: Three defects. (a) إنتِفَام for انتِقَام — qāf read as fāʾ, the same substitution seen elsewhere in the corpus (مفسوم for مقسوم). (b) The lemma ذو انتقام has lost its brackets entirely and stands in the line as though it were Niasse’s own prose; set as lemma on the strength of Q. 3:4. (c) عن عصاه does not construe.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read (ذُو انتِقَامِ) عقوبة شديدة لمن عصاه, with لمن for عن as in the Jalālayn gloss.

problems.arabic: للَّ ألَّه لَا يَحْمِى عَلَيْهِ شَيءٍ)
problems.issue: The opening of Q. 3:5 is badly scanned: للَّ ألَّه for إِنَّ اللَّهَ, with the opening bracket lost; َحْمِى for يَخْفَى (khāʾ and fāʾ read as ḥāʾ and mīm); شَيءٍ in the genitive for the nominative شَيْءٌ.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read (إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَخْفَى عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ) (Q. 3:5).

problems.arabic: (مِ الأَرْضِ وَلا فِي السَّمَاءِ) … ( هَوَ ألِذِ يُصَوِّرْكُمْ مِ الأَرْحَامِ كَيْفَ يَشَاةٍ)
problems.issue: مِ stands twice for فِي (the fāʾ and yāʾ lost), once against the correctly written فِي السَّمَاءِ in the same lemma. Also هَوَ ألِذِ for هُوَ الَّذِي, يُصَوِّرْكُمْ with sukūn for يُصَوِّرُكُمْ, and يَشَاةٍ for يَشَاءُ.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read (فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ) (Q. 3:5) and (هُوَ الَّذِي يُصَوِّرُكُمْ فِي الْأَرْحَامِ كَيْفَ يَشَاءُ) (Q. 3:6).

problems.arabic: ولا إِلَةِ إِلَّ هَوَ ٱلْعَزِيرُ الْحَكِينَ فِ صنعه
problems.issue: ٱلْعَزِيرُ for الْعَزِيزُ (zāy read as rāʾ) and الْحَكِينَ for الْحَكِيمُ (mīm read as nūn); also إِلَةِ for إِلٰهَ and إِلَّ for إِلَّا. The lemma carries no brackets and the following gloss reads فِ for في. The wāw prefixed to لا إله is not in Q. 3:6; it has been kept in translation as a connective.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read (لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ) (Q. 3:6), glossed في صنعه.

problems.arabic: كما ذكر التي صلى الله عليه وسلم من ذكورة وأنوثة
problems.issue: التي cannot be the subject of ذكر and is followed by صلى الله عليه وسلم, which marks the Prophet. النبي has been misread as التي.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read كما ذكر النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم.

problems.issue: بوما for يوماً — yāʾ read as bāʾ — against the two correct أربعين يوما that follow in the same ḥadīth.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: read أربعين يوماً نطفة.

problems.issue: The paragraph breaks off two words into the variant narration, at the page end; the subject of وقعت (feminine) is not in the text. Translated only as far as it goes, with no beginning or ending supplied.
problems.conjecture: CONJECTURE: the feminine subject is النطفة from the preceding ḥadīth, the variant presumably continuing إذا وقعت النطفة في الرحم or the like. Not supplied; continues in the next chunk.

problems.arabic: وهُوَ ألذِى أَنزَلَ عَلَيْكَ الْكِتَبَ مِنْهُ ءَايَتٌ مُحْكَمَتّ هُنَّ اُمُّ الْكِتَبِ)
problems.issue: OCR drops medial alifs (الْكِتَبَ, ءَايَتٌ, مُحْكَمَتّ) and garbles the tanwīn; the opening bracket of the lemma is missing, only the closing ')' survives, so the transcription does not mark where the lemma begins. The initial wāw is not in the āya.
problems.conjecture: هو الذي أنزل عليك الكتاب منه آيات محكمات هن أم الكتاب = Q. 3:7; lemma read as beginning at هو — conjecture.

problems.issue: Doubled wāw at the head of the lemma and a missing alif in متشابهات; again only a closing bracket.
problems.conjecture: وأخر متشابهات = Q. 3:7 — conjecture.

problems.issue: Hamza and madda lost; the passive vocalisation is damaged.
problems.conjecture: أُحْكِمَتْ آيَاتُهُ = Q. 11:1 — conjecture.

problems.issue: كلا is not construable here; it answers to the parallel محكم كله earlier in the same sentence. Translated as 'entirely muḥkam'.
problems.conjecture: فصار محكماً كلّه — conjecture.

problems.arabic: اللَّهُ نَزَّلَ أَحْسً الْحَدِيثِ كِتَاباً مُتَشَبِها مَثَانِىَ
problems.issue: أَحْسً lacks its nūn; متشابها and مثاني lose alif and the final yāʾ is mispointed.
problems.conjecture: الله نزل أحسن الحديث كتاباً متشابهاً مثاني = Q. 39:23 — conjecture.

problems.issue: qāf read as fāʾ (فُلْ for قُلْ); a spurious sukūn-alif in اْللَّهُ.
problems.conjecture: قل هو الله أحد = Q. 112:1 — conjecture.

problems.issue: The lemma is cut by the page break between ¶76 and ¶77, and both dual endings are damaged: يَدُهْ for يداه, مَبْسُوطَتَنِ for مبسوطتان. Translated across the break as the transcription has it, with the citation given in ¶77 where the lemma ends.
problems.conjecture: بل يداه مبسوطتان = Q. 5:64 — conjecture.

problems.issue: بِأَيَيْدٌ carries an intrusive yāʾ and a wrong case ending; السماء should be accusative السماءَ, which the transcription does give.
problems.conjecture: والسماء بنيناها بأيدٍ = Q. 51:47 — conjecture.

problems.arabic: وقلنا اليد القدرة التسمية تنفي هذا لأن القدرة لا تثنى لا سيما الجمع
problems.issue: التسمية ('the naming') yields a non-sequitur before لأن القدرة لا تثنى. Translated literally and flagged in the text as uncertain rather than emended.
problems.conjecture: التثنية تنفي هذا — 'the dual form refutes this', which the following clause (power is not put into the dual, much less the plural) requires — conjecture.

problems.issue: The bāʾ of the prepositional object has dropped out.
problems.conjecture: نؤمن بها على مراد الله — conjecture.

problems.arabic: من لم يعتقد أن إلى جالس فوق العرش
problems.issue: إلى stands where the subject of the clause must be; it is an OCR reading of اللّٰه, whose ligature is elsewhere mangled in this transcription. Supplied in square brackets in the translation.
problems.conjecture: من لم يعتقد أن الله جالس فوق العرش — conjecture.

problems.arabic: وفي الحديث أين كان ربنا قبل أن يخلق السماوات والأرض غمام فوق غمام والله فوق ذلك.
problems.issue: The report's answer formula has dropped out, so the question runs straight into the answer with no قال and no verb governing غمام فوق غمام. Translated as transcribed, without supplying the join.
problems.conjecture: وفي الحديث: أين كان ربنا قبل أن يخلق السماوات والأرض؟ قال: [كان في] غمام فوق غمام والله فوق ذلك — conjecture; the received wording of the report (كان في عماء) may lie behind غمام.

problems.issue: Same كلا for كلّه as in ¶76. Translated as 'all of this'.
problems.conjecture: سرد عليّ هذا كلّه — conjecture.

problems.issue: The paragraph breaks off mid-clause at the page edge: حقيقة is in construct with a noun that is not in the transcription. Translated to the point where the text stops, with nothing supplied.
problems.conjecture: لا نعرف حقيقة [ذلك] or حقيقة [هذا] — conjecture; the continuation belongs to the following page.

problems.issue: Qāf for fāʾ at the head of the lemma, and the lemma group opens with ( but is never closed.
problems.conjecture: Conjecture: فَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ زَيْغٌ (Q. 3:7). Translated accordingly.

problems.arabic: قال الرسول صلى اله عليه وسلم
problems.issue: اله for الله in the eulogy.
problems.conjecture: Conjecture: صلى اللّٰه عليه وسلم; rendered ṣ.a.w.s.

problems.issue: The lemma is badly scanned: وابتغاء has lost its bāʾ and ghayn, and the pronoun of تأويله is detached as a free hāʾ. The following gloss تفسيره secures the reading.
problems.conjecture: Conjecture: وَابْتِغَاءَ تَأْوِيلِهِ (Q. 3:7). Translated accordingly.

problems.issue: Sukūn for ḍamma on يعلم, تاويله for تأويله, and a stray colon inside the lemma delimiters.
problems.conjecture: Conjecture: وَمَا يَعْلَمُ تَأْوِيلَهُ (Q. 3:7).

problems.issue: إلا written إِلَ, الله written أللَّةُ with hamzat qaṭʿ on the article and tāʾ for hāʾ, and the delimiters are mismatched: the lemma opens with { and closes with ).
problems.conjecture: Conjecture: {إِلَّا اللَّهُ} (Q. 3:7).

problems.issue: فے for في.
problems.conjecture: Conjecture: فِي الْعِلْمِ (Q. 3:7).

problems.issue: The phrase has no governing subject or verb and sits between the three readings of the āya and the ḥadīth on seeking knowledge. Translated literally with a bracketed subject supplied; not emended.
problems.conjecture: Conjecture: وهذا علامة للعلم أيضا ('this too is a mark of knowledge'), the clause serving as the transition to the ḥadīth that follows.

problems.issue: The object pronoun of تعليمه has been lost and a comma has been scanned in after it, breaking the parallel series (تعلمه / طلبه / البحث فيه / تعليمه).
problems.conjecture: Conjecture: وتعليمُه لمن لا يعلمه صدقة. Translated as 'and teaching [it] to one who does not know it is alms.'

problems.arabic: كل من المحكم والمتشابه يقولون آمنا به   ||   [¶83] بالمتشابه كُلٌّ) من المحكم والمتشابه
problems.issue: The printed lines appear to have been read out of order across the page division. The gloss sequence runs (يقولون آمنا به) بالمتشابه (كلٌّ) من المحكم والمتشابه, and ¶83 carries exactly that order; the line closing ¶82 inverts it, putting كل من المحكم والمتشابه before يقولون آمنا به, and duplicates material that ¶83 then repeats. Translated as printed and marked in the text; the lines have not been reordered.
problems.conjecture: Conjecture: the printed order of ¶82's last line should be يقولون آمنا به [بالمتشابه] كلٌّ من المحكم والمتشابه, i.e. the same sequence as ¶83, the whole line being a displaced duplicate of the opening of ¶83.

problems.issue: A wāw has been scanned in before the lemma, which in any case has no opening delimiter, and فلوبنا stands for قلوبنا.
problems.conjecture: Conjecture: (رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا) (Q. 3:8).

problems.issue: من لدنك is scanned as صِ لَدْنكَ: مِنْ has lost its nūn and been joined to the following word, and لدنك has lost its ḍamma. The gloss من عندك secures the reading.
problems.conjecture: Conjecture: وَهَبْ لَنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ (Q. 3:8). Translated accordingly.

problems.issue: مِيةِ for فيه.
problems.conjecture: Conjecture: لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ (Q. 3:9).

problems.arabic: هُوَ ألذِة أَنزَلَ عَلَيْهَ ألْكِتَبَ مِنْهُ ءَايَتٌ مُحْكَمَتُ
problems.issue: The āya quoted inside ʿĀʾisha's report is damaged throughout: ألذِة for الذي, عَلَيْهَ for عليك, the article written with hamzat qaṭʿ (أل-), and the internal alifs of الكتاب، آيات، محكمات lost.
problems.conjecture: Conjecture: هُوَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلَ عَلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ مِنْهُ آيَاتٌ مُحْكَمَاتٌ (Q. 3:7). Translated accordingly.

problems.issue: إَلَّ for إلا, and أولوا carries the nominative plural written with a final alif.
problems.conjecture: Conjecture: إِلَّا أُولُو الْأَلْبَابِ (Q. 3:7).

problems.issue: كَبِرُوا for كفروا, and لن تغني is scanned as لْر تُغْيِيَ, the nūn of لن lost and تغني misread. The gloss تدفع secures تغني.
problems.conjecture: Conjecture: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَنْ تُغْنِيَ (Q. 3:10). Translated accordingly.

problems.issue: عنهم has acquired a wāw, and the internal alifs of أموالهم and أولادهم are lost; the article of الله is written with hamzat qaṭʿ.
problems.conjecture: Conjecture: عَنْهُمْ أَمْوَالُهُمْ وَلَا أَوْلَادُهُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ (Q. 3:10).

problems.issue: شيئا is scanned as قَيْاً, أولئك as أَوْلَيكَ, and وقود النار as وَموْ البَّارِ; the lemma has also lost its delimiters. The gloss وقود النار ما توقد به secures the reading.
problems.conjecture: Conjecture: شَيْئًا وَأُولَئِكَ هُمْ وَقُودُ النَّارِ (Q. 3:10). Translated accordingly.

problems.issue: فرعول for فرعون in the gloss.
problems.conjecture: Conjecture: كعادة آل فرعون.

problems.issue: كذبوا is scanned كَدَّبَوا, بآياتنا as بِايَيِنَا, فأخذهم as فَأَحَدَهُمُ, الله truncated to اللَّ, and the delimiters are mismatched: the lemma opens with ( and closes with }. The following gloss is truncated to أهلكر.
problems.conjecture: Conjecture: (كَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِنَا فَأَخَذَهُمُ اللَّهُ) (Q. 3:11), glossed أهلكهم ('He destroyed them'). Translated accordingly.

problems.issue: بذنوبهم is scanned يذَنُوبهمّ and the lemma has no closing delimiter; the gloss has ذنويهم for ذنوبهم.
problems.conjecture: Conjecture: (بِذُنُوبِهِمْ) بسبب ذنوبهم (Q. 3:11).

problems.issue: والله written وَالهُ, and the article of العقاب written with hamzat qaṭʿ.
problems.conjecture: Conjecture: وَاللَّهُ شَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ (Q. 3:11).

problems.arabic: أمر النبي صلى اللّٰه عليه ومله اليهود بالإسلام
problems.issue: ومله for وسلم in the eulogy.
problems.conjecture: Conjecture: صلى اللّٰه عليه وسلم; rendered ṣ.a.w.s.

problems.issue: The negative particle has been lost, which reverses the sense of the Jews' taunt: as printed it says that the Quraysh fighters did know fighting. ¶86 repeats the taunt as وهم أغمار لا يعلمون الحرب, which fixes the negation.
problems.conjecture: Conjecture: أَغْمَارًا لَا يَعْرِفُونَ الْقِتَالَ. The negation is supplied in square brackets ('who do [not] know fighting') rather than silently restored.

problems.issue: A wāw has been scanned in before the lemma, which also lacks its opening delimiter.
problems.conjecture: Conjecture: (قُلْ) (Q. 3:12).

problems.issue: وتحشرون is scanned وَتُحْشَرُولَ and جهنم as جَنَّمَ; the gloss فتدخلوها carries a stray tanwīn.
problems.conjecture: Conjecture: وَتُحْشَرُونَ إِلَى جَهَنَّمَ (Q. 3:12), glossed فتدخلوها.

problems.issue: وبئس written وَبِيسَ, and المهاد scanned as ألْيِهَادَ with hamzat qaṭʿ on the article. The gloss الفراش secures المهاد.
problems.conjecture: Conjecture: وَبِئْسَ الْمِهَادُ (Q. 3:12). Translated accordingly.

problems.arabic: هم ذكروا ي مخاطبتهم ... ا يدعو إلى الفخر
problems.issue: Two particles have lost their first letter: ي for في, and ا for لا. Without the negation the clause says that fighting raw youths does call for pride, the opposite of the argument Niasse is making.
problems.conjecture: Conjecture: في مخاطبتهم ... لا يدعو إلى الفخر. Translated with the negation, supplied in square brackets.

problems.issue: قد written فَدْ, لكم written لَكَةِ, and آية written عَايَةٌ. The gloss عبرة secures آية.
problems.conjecture: Conjecture: قَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ آيَةٌ (Q. 3:13). Translated accordingly.

problems.arabic: ( بِيَّتَيْ) فرقتين ( الْتَفَتَام ... مِيَّةٌ تُفَتِلُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ
problems.issue: في فئتين is scanned بِيَّتَيْ with the final nūn lost, التقتا as الْتَفَتَام, and فئة تقاتل as مِيَّةٌ تُفَتِلُ; the lemma delimiters are missing on both fragments. The glosses فرقتين and يوم بدر للقتال secure the reading.
problems.conjecture: Conjecture: فِي فِئَتَيْنِ الْتَقَتَا ... فِئَةٌ تُقَاتِلُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ (Q. 3:13). Translated accordingly.

problems.issue: كَابِرَةٌ reads bāʾ for fāʾ; the word is كَافِرَةٌ. The opening bracket of the lemma is missing, only the closing ')' survives, so the transcription does not mark where the lemma begins; it has been read as beginning at وَأخْرِىْ, i.e. immediately after هذا جيش النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم. Translated as 'and another, disbelieving'.
problems.conjecture: وأخرى كافرة ترونهم مثليهم = Q. 3:13; lemma read as beginning at وأخرى — conjecture.

problems.issue: Not OCR damage. تَرَوْنَهُم (2nd pl.) is the Warsh/Nāfiʿ reading against the Ḥafṣ يَرَوْنَهُم, and it is retained here. It governs the English: 'you see them as twice their number', not 'they saw them'. Niasse's exposition presupposes this reading, since he takes the disbelievers to be the ones who see the Muslims doubled. No emendation made.
problems.conjecture: No emendation. Ḥafṣ يرونهم noted only for the apparatus — conjecture that no reader will need: the Warsh form is correct as printed.

problems.issue: الْعَيْرِ reads rāʾ for nūn; the word is الْعَيْنِ. The error is the more misleading because العير ('the caravan') is a live term in this very passage, where Abū Sufyān's caravan is under discussion. Translated from the corrected reading as 'to the eye's seeing'.
problems.conjecture: رأي العين = Q. 3:13 — conjecture.

problems.arabic: هذه غزوة بدر وقعت في شوال في العام الثاني من الهجرة
problems.issue: The transcription is legible but the month is anomalous: the standard sources place Badr in Ramaḍān of year 2 AH, not Shawwāl. Translated as transcribed, with no emendation, since this may be what Niasse said rather than a transcription slip.
problems.conjecture: Possibly رمضان for شوال, but the two are not graphically confusable and no emendation is proposed — flagged as a query for the editor, not a conjecture on the Arabic.

problems.issue: The paragraph breaks off mid-sentence at the page edge: فلما ('and when') has no apodosis, which stands at the head of ¶89 (رجع). Translated to the point where the text stops, with nothing supplied.
problems.conjecture: فلما رجع رأى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم في المنام… — the clause runs on into ¶89; the break is the printed page, not the sense — conjecture.

problems.arabic: رأى الني صلى اللّه عليه وسلم في المنام
problems.issue: الني lacks the bāʾ of النبي. Translated from the corrected reading.
problems.conjecture: رأى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم — conjecture.

problems.issue: معد is not construable; the parallel clause immediately following (وأبو سفيان معه العير) requires معه. Translated as 'with him the army'.
problems.conjecture: أبو جهل معه الجيش — conjecture.

problems.issue: العبر for العير ('the caravan'), rāʾ/bāʾ confusion. The same word is spelled correctly a few lines later (فأما العير ففروا), which confirms the reading. Translated as 'the caravan'.
problems.conjecture: وأبو سفيان معه العير — conjecture.

problems.issue: الكبيل is not a sūra name and cannot be read. Marked illegible in the translation rather than emended. Two things fix the referent: the verse Niasse is pointing to (وإذ يعدكم الله إحدى الطائفتين أنها لكم) is Q. 8:7, and ¶90 — the continuation of this same paragraph's last sentence — names سورة الأنفال explicitly, as does ¶88. But الكبيل is graphically remote from الأنفال, so the damage is not a simple letter swap and may conceal a dropped word.
problems.conjecture: كما سيأتي في سورة الأنفال — conjecture, on contextual grounds only.

problems.arabic: وأما النفير فخرجوا بالز مدججين في السلاح
problems.issue: بالز is a truncated form and cannot be read. Marked illegible in the translation. مدججين في السلاح ('armed to the teeth in weapons') stands independently, so the sense of the clause survives without it.
problems.conjecture: بالبِزّ ('with their war-gear') — conjecture; بأجمعهم ('all together') is a weaker alternative.

problems.issue: وأنوا for وأتوا, tāʾ read as nūn. Translated as 'and they came to Badr'.
problems.conjecture: وأتوا إلى بدر — conjecture.

problems.arabic: هذا كانت فيه آية أي عبرة
problems.issue: Agreement failure: masculine هذا with feminine كانت, whose subject is آية, while فيه is masculine. Translated as transcribed ('In this there was a sign, that is, a lesson'), without emending the agreement.
problems.conjecture: هذا كان فيه آية, or هذه كانت فيها آية — conjecture; the oral register may simply be loose here rather than damaged.

problems.arabic: لأن النبي صلى لأ عل وسلم أخبر
problems.issue: The eulogy is reduced to صلى لأ عل وسلم; the الله ligature and عليه are both mangled. Restored to the fixed rendering ṣ.a.w.s.
problems.conjecture: صلى الله عليه وسلم — conjecture (certain from the formula).

problems.issue: أتمّم is not a word; the syntax after أخبر requires أنهم. Translated as 'announced that they would be victorious'. سيغلبون is read as active (the Muslims prevail), which the following sentence requires (فالتقوا وغلبهم المسلمون).
problems.conjecture: أخبر أنهم سيغلبون — conjecture.

problems.arabic: وفلان يصرع هنا وقيله يُصرع هنا إلى آعرهم
problems.issue: وقيله stands in a series of فلان … وفلان … clauses and cannot be read as it stands. Marked illegible in the translation rather than normalised to a third فلان, since the printed form may preserve something else.
problems.conjecture: وفلان يصرع هنا — conjecture; قَبيله ('his clan') is a weaker alternative.

problems.issue: آعرهم for آخرهم, khāʾ read as ʿayn. Translated as 'to the last of them'.
problems.conjecture: إلى آخرهم — conjecture.

problems.arabic: وأسروا منهم مسعو سيدا من ساداتهم
problems.issue: مسعو cannot be read. Marked illegible in the translation. The syntax fixes its class: سيدا is a singular accusative, which in this construction is governed by a number between 11 and 99, so a numeral stood here.
problems.conjecture: سبعين سيدا من ساداتهم ('seventy of their chiefs') — conjecture; the figure of seventy captives at Badr is the standard one, and سبعين satisfies the grammar.

problems.issue: العبلى for العباس. The patronymic بن عبد المطلب and the fact that the man is named among the Badr captives identify him. Translated as al-ʿAbbās b. ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib.
problems.conjecture: فيهم العباس بن عبد المطلب — conjecture.

problems.issue: يعتير for يعتبر, bāʾ read as yāʾ. Translated as 'for whoever takes a lesson'.
problems.conjecture: هذه عبرة لمن يعتبر — conjecture.

problems.issue: زبادة for زيادة, yāʾ read as bāʾ. Translated as 'more of'.
problems.conjecture: سيأتي زيادة … — conjecture.

problems.issue: Hamza is dropped in both occurrences of سيأتي in this paragraph. Purely orthographic; translated from the normalised form, no effect on sense.
problems.conjecture: سيأتي — conjecture (orthographic normalisation only).

problems.issue: العدي cannot be read; it is the thing of which 'more will come' in Sūrat al-Anfāl. Marked illegible in the translation. The sentence completes in ¶90.
problems.conjecture: الحديث ('further discussion') — conjecture; العدد ('the numbers', picking up the counts of the two armies rehearsed in ¶88, which Niasse has already twice deferred to Sūrat al-Anfāl) is an equally good alternative.

problems.issue: Not damage. ¶90 is a page-break fragment: it carries nothing but the completion of the last sentence of ¶89 (سياتي زبادة العدي | في سورة الأنفال). Translated as it stands, with no beginning supplied, and left as a one-run paragraph.
problems.conjecture: سيأتي زيادة … في سورة الأنفال — ¶89 and ¶90 are one sentence — conjecture as to the word damaged in ¶89, not as to the join.

problems.issue: الشيطاد for الشيطان, nūn read as dāl. Translated as 'or Satan [did]', the verb being supplied in brackets as the Arabic is elliptical.
problems.conjecture: زينها الله ابتلاء أو الشيطان — conjecture; the gloss follows al-Jalālayn on Q. 3:14 (زينه الله ابتلاء أو الشيطان), which confirms the reading.

problems.issue: اجتم lacks its final ʿayn. Translated as 'love is gathered in them'.
problems.conjecture: اجتمع فيها الحب — conjecture.

problems.arabic: ويحب شيئا يحب أن يحبد وفيه شهوته
problems.issue: يحبد for يحبه, final hāʾ read as dāl; the parallel clause just before it has يحبه correctly. Translated as 'that he loves to love'.
problems.conjecture: يحب أن يحبه — conjecture.

problems.arabic: اجتمعت كلا في الآية حب الشهوات
problems.issue: كلا for كلها, as elsewhere in this transcription. Translated as 'all of them came together in the āya'.
problems.conjecture: اجتمعت كلها في الآية — conjecture.

problems.issue: تواققه doubles the qāf for توافقه. Translated as 'a wife who suits him'.
problems.conjecture: زوجة توافقه — conjecture.

problems.issue: الْبَنِيسَ for الْبَنِينَ, nūn read as sīn; the closing bracket of the lemma is also missing. Translated as 'and sons'.
problems.conjecture: والبنين = Q. 3:14 — conjecture.

problems.issue: Hamza and medial alif lost (الانعم for الأنعام), and the opening bracket is missing. Translated as 'and cattle'.
problems.conjecture: والأنعام = Q. 3:14 — conjecture.

problems.issue: الْحَرْتِ for الْحَرْثِ, thāʾ read as tāʾ; no closing bracket. Translated as 'and tilled land', with Niasse's own gloss الزراعة following.
problems.conjecture: والحرث = Q. 3:14 — conjecture.

problems.arabic: مِنَ النِّسَاءِ)  …  (وَالْبَنِيسَ  …  وَالانْعَمِ)  …  ( وَالْحَرْتِ  …  (ذَلِكَ مَتَعُ الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا
problems.issue: Bracket damage runs through the whole lemma sequence of Q. 3:14: مِنَ النِّسَاءِ has a closing bracket only, وَالْبَنِيسَ and وَالْحَرْتِ and ذَلِكَ مَتَعُ الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا an opening bracket only, وَالانْعَمِ a closing bracket only. The boundaries between lemma and gloss have therefore been set from the Qurʾānic wording rather than from the transcription's brackets. Per the conventions the citation is given once, at the end of the run, which falls in ¶92 after حسن المآب.
problems.conjecture: (من النساء) (والبنين) (والقناطير المقنطرة من الذهب والفضة) (والخيل المسومة) (والأنعام) (والحرث) (ذلك متاع الحياة الدنيا) = Q. 3:14 throughout — conjecture as to the bracketing only.

problems.arabic: كل هذه الأشياء متاع يتمتع به في الدنيا
problems.issue: The paragraph breaks off at the page edge before the predicate is complete; ثم يفنى at the head of ¶92 continues it. Translated to the point where the text stops, with nothing supplied.
problems.conjecture: … متاع يتمتع به في الدنيا ثم يفنى — the clause runs on into ¶92 — conjecture.

problems.issue: حُسْ lacks its nūn (حُسْنُ). عِندَهُو and الْمَئَابِ are Warsh orthography, not damage, and are left as printed. Translated as 'the goodness of the final return'.
problems.conjecture: والله عنده حسن المآب = Q. 3:14 — conjecture.
